idea.title: 3 to 4 hours to reply is too slow
idea.angle: Busy agencies often take 3 to 4 hours to answer WhatsApp, Instagram DMs or texts. By then a buyer has usually messaged three other agents. More enquiries only matter if someone answers fast.
idea.hook: YOUR REPLY CAME. THE BUYER HAD GONE.

slides.heading: YOUR REPLY CAME. THE BUYER HAD **GONE**.
A FEW HOURS TO REPLY IS FINE
THE BUYER MESSAGED **3 AGENTS**
slides.body: A buyer who waits hours has usually messaged three other agents by then.

slides.heading: BUSY AGENCIES REPLY IN **HOURS**
slides.body: Many take 3 to 4 hours to answer. The buyer goes quiet and books elsewhere.

slides.heading: DECIDE WHO **REPLIES**
slides.body: Pick one person for WhatsApp, Instagram DMs and texts. Not "whoever is free".

slides.heading: SET A **REPLY** TIME
slides.body: Agree how fast every enquiry gets an answer. Then stick to it.

slides.heading: HAVE ANSWERS **READY**
slides.body: Save short replies for price, location and viewings. Answer in seconds, not hours.

caption:
Your reply was good. It was just too late.

Busy agencies often take 3 to 4 hours to answer WhatsApp, Instagram DMs or texts.
By then, the buyer has usually messaged three other agents.
More enquiries only matter if someone answers fast.
Decide who replies, set a reply time and keep short answers ready for the common questions.

idea.title: From photos to video: how it works
idea.angle: I show the simple process: you send the listing photos, AI adds slow camera moves to each one, then we add the hook, captions and the ask. No crew, no reshoot.
idea.hook: YOUR PHOTOS IN. A SMOOTH VIDEO OUT.

slides.heading: YOUR PHOTOS IN. A SMOOTH **VIDEO** OUT.
A GOOD VIDEO NEEDS A FILM DAY
YOUR PHOTOS ARE **ENOUGH**
slides.body: AI can turn the listing photos you already have into smooth, cinematic video.

slides.heading: START WITH THE **PHOTOS**
slides.body: Bright, tidy, taken from the corner of each room. Best shot first.

slides.heading: ADD SLOW **CAMERA** MOVES
slides.body: Each photo gets a calm, smooth move. Two to three seconds per shot.

slides.heading: ADD THE **HOOK**
slides.body: Your best shot with bold text, like "4-bed with pool, quiet street."

slides.heading: END WITH ONE **ASK**
slides.body: Price, location and one clear action, like "DM TOUR to book a viewing."

caption:
No crew. No reshoot. No editing at night.

Here is how a listing video gets made from photos.
Start with bright, tidy photos, best shot first.
AI adds a slow, smooth camera move to each one.
Then add a bold hook at the start and one clear ask at the end.
The result is a 15-second video of the real home.

idea.title: What AI should never do to your listing
idea.angle: Honest AI video moves through real rooms. It should never invent furniture, rooms or views. Buyers who feel misled at the viewing don't come back.
idea.hook: AI SHOULD NEVER ADD A FAKE ROOM

slides.heading: AI SHOULD NEVER ADD A **FAKE** ROOM
A LITTLE EXTRA MAKES IT SELL
BUYERS SEE IT AT THE **VIEWING**
slides.body: If the home doesn't match the video, trust breaks on the spot.

slides.heading: MISLED BUYERS DON'T **COME BACK**
slides.body: Make it look good. Keep it honest. That's the whole rule.

slides.heading: NO **FAKE** FURNITURE
slides.body: Show the rooms as they are. Clear the clutter before the photos instead.

slides.heading: NO EXTRA **ROOMS**
slides.body: Never change the layout. The video shows the home buyers will walk into.

slides.heading: NO BORROWED **VIEWS**
slides.body: No sea, city or garden that isn't really there. Show the real view.

caption:
The fastest way to lose a buyer is a video that lies.

Honest AI video moves through your real rooms.
It should never add furniture, extra rooms or a view that isn't there.
Buyers will see the real home at the viewing.
If it doesn't match, they won't come back.
Make it look good. Keep it honest.

idea.title: Myth: AI video is too expensive
idea.angle: Compare it to the real cost: a camera crew, a reshoot, or a listing that sits for months. AI works from photos you already have, so there's no shoot day to pay for.
idea.hook: "AI VIDEO MUST BE EXPENSIVE." LET'S SEE.

slides.heading: PREMIUM VIDEO NEEDS A BIG BUDGET
A LISTING THAT **SITS**
slides.body: Weeks of posts nobody stops for. That costs more than any video.

slides.heading: ADS ON POSTS THAT **DON'T WORK**
slides.body: Boosting a weak post just shows a weak post to more people.

slides.heading: NO **SHOOT DAY** NEEDED
slides.body: AI works from the photos you already have. No crew, no reshoot.

slides.heading: ONE **RENTAL** COVERS IT
slides.body: One extra rental a month covers it. It pays for itself.

slides.heading: THE REAL QUESTION IS **VALUE**
slides.body: Not "what does it cost?" but "what does a quiet listing cost me?"

caption:
Premium video sounds like a big expense. Look at what you already pay for.

A listing that sits for weeks with no messages.
Ads on posts that don't stop the scroll.
A camera crew or a reshoot, if you film it the old way.
AI works from the photos you already have, so there's no shoot day at all.
One extra rental a month covers it.

idea.title: Reel or carousel for a listing? Use both
idea.angle: A Reel helps new people find the listing; a photo carousel lets interested buyers look closely at each room. Post the 15-second video as a Reel and the best photos as a carousel, with the same keyword on both.
idea.hook: REEL OR CAROUSEL? USE BOTH, LIKE THIS.

slides.heading: REEL OR CAROUSEL? USE **BOTH**, LIKE THIS.
PICK ONE FORMAT AND STICK TO IT
EACH ONE DOES A DIFFERENT **JOB**
slides.body: Pick only one and you miss half the buyers.

slides.heading: THE REEL **FINDS** BUYERS
slides.body: Post the 15-second video as a Reel. It helps new people find the listing.

slides.heading: THE CAROUSEL **SHOWS** DETAIL
slides.body: Post your best photos as a carousel. Interested buyers look closely at each room.

slides.heading: SAME **KEYWORD** ON BOTH
slides.body: Use one keyword, like TOUR1, on both posts. You'll know which listing they mean.

slides.heading: ONE LISTING. **TWO** POSTS.
slides.body:
Before: One photo post. Then silence.
After:
✓ A 15-second Reel for reach
✓ A photo carousel for detail
✓ The same keyword on both

caption:
Reel or carousel? You don't have to choose.

A Reel helps new people find the listing.
A photo carousel lets interested buyers look closely at each room.
Post the 15-second video as a Reel and the best photos as a carousel.
Put the same keyword on both, like TOUR1, so you know which listing each message is about.
Same photos. Two formats. More buyers see it.
